description: This source file defines extension methods for the Orleans serialization framework, specifically to add support for Protobuf IMessage serialization and deserialization via the Orleans.Serializer package. It sets up dependency injection for codecs and copiers related to Protobuf types.

classes.name: SerializationHostingExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods to register Protobuf serialization support into Orleans serializer builder

methods.description: Adds support for serializing and deserializing Protobuf IMessage types to the Orleans serializer builder, configuring necessary codecs and copiers.
